9-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (63-bet). Chap yarmi TO'Q YaShIL fonda.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A World of Wonders' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '9'.

CHAP USTUN (yashil fon):
• To'q sariq 'Reading'.
4) 'Read the article and match the sentences (A - C) to the gaps (1 - 3), then explain the words in bold. Finally, answer questions 1 - 7.'
   A - The walls and floor of the chapel, as well as the lovely statues it contains, have been carved from rock salt.
   B - There are also 250 kilometres of tunnels and underground caves with huge salt crystals in strange shapes.
   C - The salt used to be dug out by hand, and until 1620 it was carried up to the surface by the miners.
   MAQOLA (krem fonda, yirtiq qog'oz): qizil-jigarrang sarlavha 'A Hidden World of Wonders'. Besh xatboshi, uchta katakchali bo'sh joy [1], [2], [3]. Qalin so'zlar: hidden, natural, man-made wonders, According to, legend, servants, lump, rock, constant, church services, was destroyed, wooden, sculptures, solid rock, attraction, sights.

O'NG USTUN:
• Savollar 1-7: 1 Where is the Wieliczka Salt Mine? 2 According to legend, what happened when Kinga's servants dug a well at Wieliczka? 3 How was salt removed from the mine before 1620? 4 How did the constant danger affect the miners? 5 Why did the miners start to carve sculptures from the rock salt? 6 Where is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga? 7 What can you see in the underground caves?
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.

Qiya: dig, church, deeply, hidden, salt, solid, special, carve, lump, unforgettable. 1 a ... world 2 ... religious 3 ... services 4 ... rock 5 a ... of salt | 6 ... crystals 7 a ... attraction 8 to ... sculptures 9 to ... a well 10 ... sights
6) 'Fill in the opposites from the list.' Qiya: ugly, safe, bored, ordinary, man-made, tiny. 1 natural ≠ 2 dangerous ≠ 3 enormous ≠ | 4 beautiful ≠ 5 strange ≠ 6 amazed ≠
7) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 ... southern Poland; 2 ... the surface; 3 to travel ... Marmaros ... Cracow; 4 to stop ... Wieliczka; 5 to carve sth ... rock salt; 6 ... over seven centuries; 7 she threw her ring ... a salt mine
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Look at the headings below and match the words/phrases in the list to the appropriate heading. Then, talk about the Wieliczka Salt Mine.' Ko'k sarlavhalar: Place/Location - Legend - History of the Place - Things to See/Do - Recommendation. Qiya ro'yxat: threw her ring, sights, near Cracow, chapels, dig a well, Poland, Blessed Kinga, Wieliczka Salt Mine, horses were used to carry salt out, enormous chambers, missing ring was found, miners were killed or injured, chapel was destroyed by fire, caves with huge salt crystals, carve sculptures from rock salt, will be amazed, tunnels

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '63'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI (bo'sh joylar to'ldirilgan).


⚠ 9-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - MAJHUL
  NISBAT (THE PASSIVE) MATNDA:

  'Not much CAN BE SEEN'
  'visitors ARE TAKEN down'
  'her servants WERE TOLD to dig'
  'salt WAS DISCOVERED'
  'the first lump ... WAS TAKEN out'
  'Kinga's ring WAS FOUND'
  'salt HAS BEEN MINED'
  'The salt USED TO BE DUG out'
  'it WAS CARRIED up'
  'horses WERE USED'
  'miners WERE KILLED or INJURED'
  'chapels WERE CONSTRUCTED'
  'church services WERE HELD'
  'a chapel WAS DESTROYED'
  'miners WERE NOT ALLOWED'
  'visitors ARE SHOWN'
  'HAVE BEEN DUG out'
  'HAVE BEEN CARVED'
  'WAS MADE by the miners'
  'You WILL BE AMAZED'
  'SHOULD NOT BE MISSED'

  ⚠ be + 3-ShAKL. Keyingi betda
  tushuntiriladi.

points.en: Near Cracow, in southern Poland, is the Wieliczka Salt Mine. Not much can be seen above the surface, but visitors are taken down into a hidden world of natural and man-made wonders.
points.uz: Polsha janubidagi Krakov yaqinida Wieliczka tuz koni joylashgan. Yer yuzasida ko'p narsa ko'rinmaydi, lekin tashrif buyuruvchilar tabiiy va inson yaratgan mo''jizalarning yashirin dunyosiga olib tushiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'can be seen', 'are taken' - MAJHUL nisbat.
⚠ 'hidden' = yashirin.
⚠ 'man-made' = inson yaratgan.

points.en: According to a 700-year-old legend, a princess called the Blessed Kinga threw her ring into a salt mine at Marmaros in Hungary. While travelling from Marmaros to Cracow, she stopped at Wieliczka and her servants were told to dig a well.
points.uz: 700 yillik afsonaga ko'ra, Muborak Kinga ismli malika uzugini Vengriyaning Marmaros shahridagi tuz koniga tashlagan. Marmarosdan Krakovga sayohat qilayotganda u Wieliczkada to'xtagan va xizmatkorlariga quduq qazish buyurilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'according to' = ... ga ko'ra.
⚠ 'a legend' = afsona.
⚠ 'a servant' = xizmatkor.
⚠ 'were told to dig' - majhul.

points.en: Instead of water, salt was discovered - and in the first lump of salt which was taken out, Kinga's ring was found!
points.uz: Suv o'rniga tuz topilgan - va chiqarilgan birinchi tuz bo'lagida Kinganing uzugi topilgan!

points.en: The legend is just a story - but it is true that for over seven centuries salt has been mined from the rock below the town of Wieliczka. [1 - C] The salt used to be dug out by hand, and until 1620 it was carried up to the surface by the miners.
points.uz: Afsona - shunchaki hikoya, lekin yetti asrdan ortiq vaqt davomida Wieliczka shahri ostidagi tog' jinsidan tuz qazib olingani haqiqat. [1 - C] Tuz qo'lda qazib olinardi va 1620 yilgacha konchilar uni yuzaga olib chiqishardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'for over seven centuries' = yetti asrdan
ortiq.
⚠ 'has been mined' - present perfect majhul.
⚠ 'rock' = tog' jinsi.

points.en: After that date, horses were used to carry the salt out, but the work was still very dangerous and many miners were killed or injured. The constant danger made the miners deeply religious and chapels were constructed underground where church services were held.
points.uz: O'sha sanadan keyin tuzni olib chiqish uchun otlardan foydalanilgan, lekin ish baribir juda xavfli edi va ko'p konchilar halok bo'lgan yoki jarohatlangan. Doimiy xavf konchilarni chuqur dindor qilgan va yer ostida cherkov xizmatlari o'tkaziladigan ibodatxonalar qurilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'constant' = doimiy.
⚠ 'church services' = cherkov xizmatlari
(ibodat).
⚠ 'to hold a service' = ibodat o'tkazmoq.

points.en: After a chapel was destroyed by fire in 1697, miners were not allowed to take wooden statues into the mine, so they began to carve sculptures from rock salt.
points.uz: 1697 yilda bir ibodatxona yong'inda vayron bo'lgandan keyin konchilarga yog'och haykallarni konga olib kirish taqiqlangan, shuning uchun ular tosh tuzdan haykallar o'yishni boshlagan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'was destroyed by fire' - majhul + sabab.
⚠ 'were not allowed to' = ruxsat berilmagan.
⚠ 'wooden' = yog'ochdan.
⚠ 'a sculpture' = haykal.

points.en: Nowadays visitors are shown how salt was mined long ago, and can see the enormous chambers which have been dug out of the solid rock. They can also see pretty green lakes, and chapels with beautiful carvings. [2 - B] There are also 250 kilometres of tunnels and underground caves with huge salt crystals in strange shapes.
points.uz: Hozirgi kunda tashrif buyuruvchilarga uzoq o'tmishda tuz qanday qazilgani ko'rsatiladi va ular qattiq tog' jinsidan qazib olingan ulkan zallarni ko'rishi mumkin. Ular yana chiroyli yashil ko'llar va go'zal o'ymakorlikli ibodatxonalarni ko'rishi mumkin. [2 - B] Bundan tashqari, 250 kilometr tunnellar va g'alati shakldagi ulkan tuz kristallari bilan yer osti g'orlari bor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'nowadays' = hozirgi kunda.
⚠ 'solid rock' = qattiq tog' jinsi.
⚠ 'enormous' = ulkan.

points.en: A special attraction is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga, which was made by the miners themselves in a chamber 100 metres underground. [3 - A] The walls and floor of the chapel, as well as the lovely statues it contains, have been carved from rock salt.
points.uz: Alohida diqqatga sazovor joy - Muborak Kinga ibodatxonasi; uni konchilarning o'zlari yer ostida 100 metr chuqurlikdagi zalda yasagan. [3 - A] Ibodatxonaning devorlari va poli, shuningdek undagi go'zal haykallar tosh tuzdan o'yilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'by the miners THEMSELVES' - o'zlari.
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek.
⚠ 'have been carved' - present perfect majhul.

points.en: You will be amazed by these unforgettable sights, which should definitely not be missed by any visitor to the Cracow area.
points.uz: Siz bu unutilmas manzaralardan hayratga tushasiz - Krakov hududiga kelgan har qanday tashrif buyuruvchi ularni albatta o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'will be amazed' - kelasi zamon majhul.
⚠ 'unforgettable' = unutilmas.
⚠ 'sights' = manzaralar, diqqatga sazovor
joylar.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and match the sentences (A - C) to the gaps (1 - 3).
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va gaplarni (A-C) bo'sh joylarga (1-3) moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh BO'Sh JOY - UCh GAP.

  1 → C ('The salt used to be dug
    out by hand ... until 1620' -
    keyin 'After that date, horses
    were used' - 1620 ni ko'rsatadi)
  2 → B ('There are ALSO 250
    kilometres of tunnels' - ko'llar
    va ibodatxonalar ro'yxatiga
    qo'shiladi)
  3 → A ('The walls and floor of
    THE CHAPEL' - Kinga ibodatxonasi
    haqida gapdan keyin)


⚠ IShORALAR:

  'After THAT DATE' → oldin sana
  bo'lishi kerak (1620) → C
  'There are ALSO' → oldin boshqa
  narsalar sanalgan → B
  'THE chapel' → oldin aniq
  ibodatxona eslatilgan → A

pairs.left: Gap 1 — ... salt has been mined from the rock below the town of Wieliczka. [1] After that date, horses were used ...
pairs.right: C — The salt used to be dug out by hand, and until 1620 it was carried up to the surface by the miners.
pairs.rightUz: C — Tuz qo'lda qazilardi va 1620 yilgacha konchilar olib chiqardi.

pairs.left: Gap 2 — ... chapels with beautiful carvings. [2] A special attraction is ...
pairs.right: B — There are also 250 kilometres of tunnels and underground caves with huge salt crystals in strange shapes.
pairs.rightUz: B — Yana 250 km tunnellar va kristalli g'orlar bor.

pairs.left: Gap 3 — ... the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga ... 100 metres underground. [3] You will be amazed ...
pairs.right: A — The walls and floor of the chapel, as well as the lovely statues it contains, have been carved from rock salt.
pairs.rightUz: A — Ibodatxonaning devorlari, poli va haykallari tosh tuzdan o'yilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then explain the words in bold.

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI SAVOL - JAVOBLAR MAQOLADA.

⚠ 3-SAVOL: 'How WAS salt REMOVED?'

⚠ 'TO AFFECT':

  ⚠ 'effect' (ot) = ta'sir.

items.en: 1 Where is the Wieliczka Salt Mine?
items.answerEn: It is near Cracow, in southern Poland.

items.en: 2 According to legend, what happened when Kinga's servants dug a well at Wieliczka?
items.uz: 2 Afsonaga ko'ra, Kinganing xizmatkorlari Wieliczkada quduq qazganda nima bo'ldi?
items.answerEn: Instead of water, they discovered salt, and Kinga's ring was found in the first lump of salt.
items.answerUz: Suv o'rniga tuz topishdi va birinchi tuz bo'lagida Kinganing uzugi topildi.

items.en: 3 How was salt removed from the mine before 1620?
items.uz: 3 1620 yilgacha tuz kondan qanday olib chiqilardi?
items.answerEn: It was dug out by hand and carried up to the surface by the miners.
items.answerUz: U qo'lda qazilardi va konchilar yuzaga olib chiqardi.

items.en: 4 How did the constant danger affect the miners?

items.uz: 5 Nega konchilar tosh tuzdan haykal o'yishni boshladi?
items.answerEn: Because after a chapel was destroyed by fire in 1697, they were not allowed to take wooden statues into the mine.
items.answerUz: Chunki 1697 yilda ibodatxona yong'inda vayron bo'lgandan keyin ularga yog'och haykallarni konga olib kirish taqiqlandi.

items.en: 6 Where is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga?
items.answerEn: It is in a chamber 100 metres underground.
items.answerUz: U yer ostida 100 metr chuqurlikdagi zalda.

items.en: 7 What can you see in the underground caves?
items.uz: 7 Yer osti g'orlarida nimani ko'rish mumkin?
items.answerEn: You can see huge salt crystals in strange shapes.
items.answerUz: G'alati shakldagi ulkan tuz kristallarini ko'rish mumkin.

exercises.exampleEn: The Wieliczka Salt Mine is near Cracow, in Poland.
exercises.exampleUz: Wieliczka tuz koni Polshada, Krakov yaqinida joylashgan.
modelAnswers: The Wieliczka Salt Mine is near Cracow, in Poland.
According to legend, the Blessed Kinga threw her ring into a salt mine in Hungary. When her servants dug a well at Wieliczka, they found salt and her missing ring.

For centuries salt was dug out by hand, and later horses were used to carry it out. Many miners were killed or injured. After a chapel was destroyed by fire, the miners began to carve sculptures from rock salt.
Today visitors can see enormous chambers, chapels, tunnels and caves with huge salt crystals.
You will be amazed by these unforgettable sights - don't miss them!
modelAnswersUz: Wieliczka tuz koni Polshada, Krakov yaqinida joylashgan.
Afsonaga ko'ra, Muborak Kinga uzugini Vengriyadagi tuz koniga tashlagan. Xizmatkorlari Wieliczkada quduq qazganda tuz va yo'qolgan uzukni topishgan.

Asrlar davomida tuz qo'lda qazilgan, keyin uni olib chiqish uchun otlardan foydalanilgan. Ko'p konchilar halok bo'lgan yoki jarohatlangan. Ibodatxona yong'inda vayron bo'lgandan keyin konchilar tosh tuzdan haykal o'yishni boshlagan.
Bugun tashrif buyuruvchilar ulkan zallar, ibodatxonalar, tunnellar va ulkan tuz kristallari bilan g'orlarni ko'rishi mumkin.
Bu unutilmas manzaralardan hayratga tushasiz - ularni o'tkazib yubormang!
